race.description: Tradepro’s Time For A New Bathroom Mdn Hcp
race.comment: OVEROPTOMYSTIC (1) is hard to look past after resuming with a head-defeat at Gatton when well found by the market. Draws to get all the favours from the inside alley and should eat up the extra ground. SLIGHTLY SQUEEZE (4) has a genuine case through his third at this track two runs back and now comes out of an Eagle Farm mid-week race where he made ground despite racing keenly and hanging out. OAKFIELD GALAXY (11) is a seasoned maiden, yet his second at this venue behind Dun Darte Cheap reads well for this and last start at Ipswich included a check. QUARTZOPOLIS (6) is on the short turnaround and has been showing glimpses without putting a full race together. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
